metadata.title: Journalism: Norms, Crisis, and Digital Disruption
Journalism: Norms, Crisis, and Digital Disruption

sections.text: Journalism is the practice of gathering, verifying, and distributing information about public affairs. Its institutional claim to democratic importance rests on the watchdog function -- holding power accountable -- and the public sphere function -- providing shared factual grounding for civic deliberation. Both functions are under severe structural stress from digital disruption of the revenue model.
